title: gif-workspace.spec flake: the stage test plants masks while Reverse's reload is still in flight
description: Observed 2026-09-20 verifying MPI-859: 'gif stage: right-click reverses the frames and clears every mask' failed 1 run in 4 when gif-cutout.spec.js and gif-workspace.spec.js run together. The test waits only for the /gif/entry REQUEST, then calls setTrackMasks; the reverse's response then runs loadFrames -> _syncMasks, whose new frame signature stashes and empties the masks, so hasFrameMasks() polls false for 5s. Not MPI-859.
